info.text:
One quarter brought Macy's about 35% of its fiscal 2025 sales.

Macy's holiday quarter (Nov 2025-Jan 2026): $7.6B of $21.8B in fiscal 2025 net sales.
Its gross margin rate was 39.2%, 39.7% and 39.4% in Q1-Q3, then 35.2% in Q4. Macy's attributed Q4's 0.5-point year-over-year decline mainly to about 0.6 points of tariff impact.
Hypothetical doorbuster: a TV that cost $300 sells for $280 (-$20), plus $100 of add-ons at a 40% margin (+$40) = +$20 basket.
Retailers expected 17% of 2025 holiday sales to be returned.

Sources: Macy's, Inc. FY2025 10-K and quarterly results (2025-2026); NRF and Happy Returns, 2025 Retail Returns Landscape (Oct 2025).
